summary: Frontend-only testing for ARCHAUDIT model-select gating bug fix and regressions. Verified: (1) BUG FIX — none of the <option> elements in [data-testid=model-select] carry the disabled attribute for free users; all 3 options are clickable. (2) FREE-TIER GATING — selecting 'gemini' or 'nvidia' as a free user opens a NEW tab to https://buy.stripe.com/test_28E5kFdwa68k6Ni4Du0Fi00 and the dropdown value stays at 'gpt-4o-mini'; selecting 'gpt-4o-mini' does NOT open a new tab. (3) PRO TIER via ?pro=true — pro-badge appears, go-pro-button disappears, ?pro=true is stripped from URL, localStorage 'archaudit-pro'='true'; selecting 'gemini' and 'nvidia' actually sets the model (no Stripe tab opened). (4) PRO AUDIT — running EXECUTE AUDIT with gemini populates column-architect-loaded, column-chaos-loaded, column-hardened-loaded end-to-end. (5) REGRESSION — free-tier gpt-4o-mini audit populates all three column-*-loaded panels. All 5 acceptance criteria PASS.

issues: Architect and Hardened columns rendered with 'STAGE_FAILED — SHOWING CACHED FALLBACK' banner while Chaos was Verified. column-*-loaded testids still appeared and content displayed (regression criterion met). This appears to be a real gemini streaming/parse failure being masked by the cached-fallback UI. Consider surfacing the underlying error or verifying gemini SSE parsing for architect_done/final_done stages. Not a blocker for the reported bug fix.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate why the gemini path frequently falls back to STAGE_FAILED cached fallback on architect and hardened stages (only chaos returned live). SSE event parsing or provider rate/format may differ from OpenAI path.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx is ~1268 lines — consider splitting Header/model-select, audit columns, and SSE consumer into separate modules (>700 line threshold).

Free-tier gating logic relies purely on client-side isPro flag from localStorage/query param; backend /api/audit does not enforce model access. A free user could hit gemini/nvidia via direct API call. If Pro is meant to be a real revenue gate, enforce on backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for clickable gemini/nvidia dropdown options is verified working end-to-end on preview URL. Free-tier opens Stripe test payment link in new tab; Pro tier via ?pro=true unlocks models. Pro gemini audit occasionally shows cached fallback on architect/hardened stages (chaos succeeded live) — not a blocker but worth watching. Use context.expect_page() to detect the Stripe new-tab; localStorage.removeItem('archaudit-pro') + reload resets to free.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: <option> elements for gemini/nvidia had the disabled attribute so free users could not click them. Fix: options no longer set disabled; instead onChange checks (!isPro && v !== 'gpt-4o-mini') and calls goPro() (opens Stripe link in new tab) while leaving model state at gpt-4o-mini. A separate mount effect coerces model back to gpt-4o-mini for non-Pro. Verified in App.tsx lines ~999-1030 and via DOM inspection at runtime.
